tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.2: Perhaps the scenery is not so splendid;
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.3: Perhaps the structures are not so grand;
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.4: But what has been seen shall be recorded.
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.5: The diary grows thicker day by day,
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.6: As the journey reaches ever farther.
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.7: On a day like any other,
tooltip.the_long_travail.dialogue.10: Farewell, memories of all these eyes have seen.

tooltip.the_long_travail.flourishing.mal:
• Health recovery -%1$s

• while current health is above %2$s of maximum health, damage taken ×%3$s
tooltip.the_long_travail.flourishing.wit:
• Health recovery grows stronger with every biome type traversed

• each biome grants +%1$s
tooltip.the_long_travail.abyss.malice.ef:
• Take %1$s true damage every %2$s seconds while in fluid

• mining speed reduced by %3$s

• suffocation, cramming, drowning and freezing damage taken is multiplied by %4$s
tooltip.the_long_travail.abyss.witness.e:
• While in fluid, incoming damage has a %1$s chance to be negated

• immune to suffocation, cramming, drowning and freezing damage
tooltip.the_long_travail.far_reach.malic:
• When attacked, remove 1 random buff, with a %1$s chance to remove all buffs

• when dealing damage, there is a %2$s chance to remove 1 random buff

• this attack-triggered curse can activate at most once every %3$s seconds
tooltip.the_long_travail.far_reach.witne:
• New buffs gain a fixed +%1$s levels

• every %2$s seconds, remove %3$s random debuffs

• if fewer than %3$s are present, gain random buffs equal to the difference for %4$s seconds
tooltip.the_long_travail.deep_valley.mal:
• When attacked, there is a %1$s chance to gain Visual Deprivation for %2$s seconds

• when dealing damage, there is a %3$s chance to gain Stiff for %4$s seconds
tooltip.the_long_travail.deep_valley.wit:
• Immune to Darkness and Blindness

• when dealing damage, gain Swiftness %1$s for %2$s seconds and %3$s random buffs for %4$s seconds

• triggers at most once every %5$s seconds
tooltip.the_long_travail.underworld.mali:
• Damage dealt -%1$s

tooltip.the_long_travail.underworld.witn:
• Anvil level cost cannot exceed %1$s

• Fortune +%2$s

• Looting +%3$s

• fishing has a %4$s chance to grant extra loot and a %5$s chance to reel in an extra entity
tooltip.the_long_travail.boundless.malic:
• Cannot deal damage while flying or gliding with an elytra

• movement speed -%2$s while above Y %1$s
tooltip.the_long_travail.boundless.witne:
• +%1$s generic Curios slots

• scan every %3$s seconds, executing phantoms within %2$s blocks of the wearer and granting extra loot
